title: Irrational fear
subtitle: 「不合理的恐懼／恐懼症／過度害怕」，究竟是哪一種 irrational fear？
description: 「不合理的恐懼／恐懼症／過度害怕」，究竟是哪一種 irrational fear？

words.meaning: 不合理的恐懼；無理據的害怕
words.note: 最直接的日常改寫之一，表示恐懼的程度或理由與實際風險不相稱。
words.example: He developed an unreasonable fear of travelling by lift.

exercises.original: He developed an irrational fear of travelling by lift even though he knew the lift was regularly inspected.
exercises.zh: 即使知道升降機定期檢查，他仍對乘搭升降機產生不合理恐懼。
exercises.upgrade: unreasonable fear · 不合理的恐懼；無理據的害怕

options.explanation: he knew the lift was regularly inspected 顯示主觀恐懼缺乏與風險相稱的理由，unreasonable fear 最自然。
強調程度過高，不必然表示完全沒有理由。 本題的決定性線索集中在另一個維度，因此不如 unreasonable fear 精確。

重點是缺乏證據或事實基礎。 本題的決定性線索集中在另一個維度，因此不如 unreasonable fear 精確。

words.meaning: 恐懼症；強烈而持續的特定恐懼
words.note: 可指對特定事物或情境的強烈、持續恐懼；在臨床語境有更嚴格含義，日常語言則有時較寬鬆。
words.example: She has a phobia of spiders.

exercises.original: She has a long-standing irrational fear of spiders and avoids rooms where she thinks one may be present.
exercises.zh: 她長期害怕蜘蛛，甚至會避開可能有蜘蛛的房間。
exercises.upgrade: phobia · 恐懼症；強烈而持續的特定恐懼

options.explanation: 特定對象 + 長期 + avoidance 是 phobia of spiders 的典型語境；但這個詞在臨床診斷中仍有更嚴格標準。
強調持續時間，不自動表示不合理或極端。 本題的決定性線索集中在另一個維度，因此不如 phobia 精確。
強調強度，不自動表示持續或不合理。 本題的決定性線索集中在另一個維度，因此不如 phobia 精確。

words.example: The incident left him with an excessive fear of minor mistakes.

exercises.original: The child showed an irrational fear of a minor classroom mistake and became extremely upset.

options.explanation: minor mistake 與極強反應形成程度落差，核心是 fear 過度。

exercises.original: The report described an irrational fear of a statistically tiny risk.
exercises.zh: 報告描述對統計上極小風險的不成比例恐懼。

words.example: The rumour created an unfounded fear that the water was unsafe.

exercises.original: A false rumour created an irrational fear that the drinking water was contaminated.
exercises.zh: 虛假謠言造成食水受污染的毫無根據恐懼。

falseSynonyms.zh: anxiety 是較廣的焦慮、緊張或擔憂狀態，不一定針對明確對象，也不一定不合理。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She felt anxious before the exam. He had an irrational fear of harmless insects.

falseSynonyms.zh: worry 偏反覆擔心可能出問題，強度通常低於 fear。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She worried about missing the train. He had an irrational fear that the train would crash.

falseSynonyms.zh: caution 可以是對真實風險的合理小心，不等於不合理恐懼。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Caution is sensible on an icy road. An irrational fear may persist even when the risk is tiny.

falseSynonyms.zh: dislike 是不喜歡，不包含 fear。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She dislikes crowded restaurants. She has an irrational fear of enclosed spaces.

falseSynonyms.zh: panic 是突然、急劇的恐慌反應；irrational fear 可以長期存在而沒有每次都進入 panic。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He panicked when the alarm sounded. His irrational fear of alarms had existed for years.

falseSynonyms.zh: terror 表示極強烈恐懼，但恐懼可以有充分理由；它不自帶 irrational 的含義。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The explosion caused terror. His fear of a harmless button was irrational.

falseSynonyms.zh: phobia 很接近，但臨床語境通常要求更具體的持續模式與功能影響；普通 irrational fear 不應自動視為診斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He has an irrational fear of making mistakes. She was treated for a specific phobia.

falseSynonyms.zh: fear 是名詞／動詞；fearful 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Fear can affect decision-making. He felt fearful before the procedure.
